#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects — Institutional Meridian poster v3 (pristine)
A1 portrait 3508 × 4961 @ 150 dpi
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

W, H   = 3508, 4961
DPI    = 150
FONTS  = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

img  = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F4F1EA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = "#0C2847"
COBALT     = "#1A4A8A"
STEEL      = "#5A7FA8"
GOLD       = "#C4891E"
GOLD_LITE  = "#D9A84E"
LINEN      = "#F4F1EA"
OFF_WHITE  = "#EBE7DE"
DARK       = "#111827"
MID        = "#374151"
LIGHT      = "#6B7280"
RULE_CLR   = "#C5C0B5"
NAVY_CARD  = "#112B50"
COBALT_DK  = "#153D78"

# ── Font loader ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONTS, name), size)

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(t, f):
    b = f.getbbox(t); return b[2]-b[0]

def th(t, f):
    b = f.getbbox(t); return b[3]-b[1]

def t(text, x, y, f, fill=DARK, anchor="lt"):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def ct(text, cx, y, f, fill=DARK):
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor="mt")

def rule(y, x0=190, x1=W-190, c=RULE_CLR, w=2):
    draw.line([(x0, y),(x1, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def rr(x0, y0, x1, y1, r=16, fill=None, outline=None, ow=2):
    if fill:    draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline: draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, outline=outline, width=ow)

def wrap(text, f, maxw):
    words, lines, cur = text.split(), [], []
    for w in words:
        test = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if tw(test, f) <= maxw: cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def wt(text, x, y, f, maxw, fill=DARK, gap=8):
    cy = y
    for ln in wrap(text, f, maxw):
        t(ln, x, cy, f, fill=fill)
        cy += th(ln, f)+gap
    return cy

def eyebrow(label, y, x=190):
    t(label.upper(), x, y, F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=GOLD)
    return y + 58

# ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML = 190
MR = W-190
CW = MR-ML      # 3128 px


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HDR_H = 540
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, HDR_H], fill=NAVY)
draw.rectangle([0, HDR_H, W, HDR_H+7], fill=GOLD)

t("WORLD BANK GROUP", ML, 52, F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 46), fill=GOLD)
t("GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS  ·  2025", ML, 110,
  F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 40), fill="#7A9DC0")

t("RESILIENCE", ML, 170, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 230), fill=LINEN)
t("AMID UNCERTAINTY", ML, 375, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 130), fill="#7A9DC0")

tag1 = "The global economy's strongest recovery"
tag2 = "in six decades — and the risks ahead"
t(tag1, MR, 352, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill="#7A9DC0", anchor="rt")
t(tag2, MR, 410, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

t("Annual Report · 2025", MR, 62, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 40), fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

y = HDR_H + 76

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. HEADLINE METRICS — three clean cards, no text overlap
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = eyebrow("Historic Recovery", y)
rule(y, c=GOLD, w=3); y += 38

CARD_W = (CW - 2*52) // 3
CARD_H = 320

def metric_card(cx, cy, big_num, big_sz, sub_lbl, sub_sz,
                line1, line2, bg, num_col, sub_col, txt_col):
    mid = cx + CARD_W//2
    rr(cx, cy, cx+CARD_W, cy+CARD_H, r=18, fill=bg)
    # Large number — centred in upper portion
    ct(big_num, mid, cy+18, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", big_sz), fill=num_col)
    # Sub-label — sits immediately below big num
    num_bottom = cy + 18 + big_sz - 20
    ct(sub_lbl, mid, num_bottom, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", sub_sz), fill=sub_col)
    # Hairline separator
    sep_y = num_bottom + sub_sz + 14
    rule(sep_y, x0=cx+50, x1=cx+CARD_W-50,
         c="#FFFFFF44" if bg==NAVY_CARD else "#C5C0B5", w=1)
    # Bottom labels
    ct(line1, mid, sep_y+18, F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=txt_col)
    ct(line2, mid, sep_y+70, F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38), fill=txt_col)

metric_card(ML,                    y, "6",    200, "DECADES",   72,
            "STRONGEST RECOVERY", "SINCE 1960",
            NAVY_CARD, GOLD, "#8BB0D0", "#7A9DC0")

metric_card(ML + CARD_W + 52,     y, "1.2B",  170, "YOUTH",     68,
            "ENTERING WORKING AGE", "NEXT DECADE",
            OFF_WHITE, NAVY, COBALT, LIGHT)

metric_card(ML + 2*(CARD_W+52),   y, "2030",  170, "TARGETS",   68,
            "WORLD BANK GROUP", "STRATEGIC PRIORITIES",
            COBALT_DK, LINEN, GOLD_LITE, "#8BB0D0")

y += CARD_H + 76

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. RISKS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Risks to the Outlook", y)
t("Key Downside Risks", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Downside Risks", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96)) + 16
t("Growth could falter if trade tensions escalate or financial conditions deteriorate sharply.",
  ML, y, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill=STEEL)
y += 80

risks = [
    ("01", "Trade Tensions",
     "Escalating tariffs & retaliatory measures disrupt supply chains, dampen investment."),
    ("02", "Financial Volatility",
     "Sentiment deterioration tightens financing conditions, especially for EMDEs."),
    ("03", "Inventory Correction",
     "Firms drawing down front-loaded stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
    ("04", "Climate Shocks",
     "Extreme weather threatens agricultural output & infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
]

RISK_W = (CW - 52) // 2
RISK_H = 238
RISK_GAP = 28

for i, (num, title, body) in enumerate(risks):
    col, row = i%2, i//2
    rx = ML + col*(RISK_W+52)
    ry = y + row*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP)
    bg = "#EBF0F7" if col==0 else OFF_WHITE
    rr(rx, ry, rx+RISK_W, ry+RISK_H, r=14, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([rx, ry, rx+7, ry+RISK_H], fill=GOLD)
    t(num,   rx+28, ry+16, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf",  40), fill=GOLD)
    t(title, rx+28, ry+64, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",   60), fill=NAVY)
    wt(body, rx+28, ry+136, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 46),
       maxw=RISK_W-58, fill=MID, gap=8)

y += 2*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. POLICY ACTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Policy Framework", y)
t("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 40

policies = [
    ("Trade",      ["Multilateral environment", "Diversify trade partners"]),
    ("Finance",    ["Ease EMDE constraints", "Macro policy frameworks"]),
    ("Climate",    ["Scale risk mitigation", "Resilient infrastructure"]),
    ("Investment", ["Catalyze private capital", "Remove bottlenecks"]),
    ("Jobs",       ["Cross-border mobility", "Skills development"]),
]

POL_W = (CW - 4*20) // 5
POL_H = 256

for i, (area, actions) in enumerate(policies):
    px = ML + i*(POL_W+20)
    py = y
    bg = "#E2EBF5" if i%2==0 else OFF_WHITE
    tc = NAVY if i%2==0 else COBALT
    rr(px, py, px+POL_W, py+POL_H, r=12, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([px, py, px+POL_W, py+6], fill=COBALT)
    ct(area, px+POL_W//2, py+18, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56), fill=tc)
    rule(py+86, x0=px+16, x1=px+POL_W-16, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    cy = py+100
    for ln in actions:
        ct(ln, px+POL_W//2, cy, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 40), fill=MID)
        cy += 54

y += POL_H + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. WORLD BANK 2030 TARGETS — fixed layout: name | value | description, no overlap
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("World Bank Group 2030 Targets", y)
t("Strategic Priorities", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Strategic Priorities", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 36

targets = [
    ("Health Services",  "1.5B",  "people — quality, affordable health services"),
    ("Mission 300",      "300M",  "people in Sub-Saharan Africa — electricity access"),
    ("AgriConnect",      "300M",  "farmers — moving up the agricultural value chain"),
    ("Women's Capital",  "80M",   "women & women-led businesses — access to capital"),
    ("Water Forward",    "1B+",   "people — improved water security · 400M WBG commitment"),
]

# Column x-positions (non-overlapping)
INIT_X    = ML + 24    # initiative name
INIT_MAXW = 340
NUM_X     = ML + 420   # big number starts here
NUM_MAXW  = 290        # max width of number glyph before desc starts
DESC_X    = ML + 730   # description column
DESC_MAXW = MR - DESC_X - 20

TGT_ROW = 112
TGT_GAP = 10

for i, (init, val, desc) in enumerate(targets):
    ty = y + i*(TGT_ROW+TGT_GAP)
    if i%2==0:
        draw.rectangle([ML, ty-4, MR, ty+TGT_ROW+4], fill=OFF_WHITE)
    draw.rectangle([ML, ty, ML+6, ty+TGT_ROW-4], fill=COBALT)

    # Initiative name — vertically centred in row
    t(init, INIT_X, ty + (TGT_ROW - th(init, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 50)))//2,
      F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 50), fill=NAVY)

    # Value number
    t(val, NUM_X, ty + (TGT_ROW - th(val, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)))//2,
      F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86), fill=GOLD)

    # Description
    t(desc, DESC_X, ty + (TGT_ROW - th(desc, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 44)))//2,
      F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=MID)

y += len(targets)*(TGT_ROW+TGT_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. RESEARCH THEMES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Analytical Depth", y)
t("Key Research Themes", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Research Themes", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 36

themes = [
    ("Fiscal Policy",
     "Rebuilding fiscal space · Fiscal rules · Small-state challenges"),
    ("Trade & Supply Chains",
     "High trade costs — causes & remedies · COVID-19 supply chain impact"),
    ("Commodity Markets",
     "Price cycle drivers · Russia-Ukraine energy implications"),
    ("Financial Spillovers",
     "Rising U.S. interest rates · Rapid debt buildup dynamics"),
    ("Pandemic Economics",
     "COVID-19 income inequality · Regional macroeconomic implications"),
]

TH_COL_W = (CW-60)//2
TH_ROW   = 124
TH_GAP   = 12

for i, (theme, detail) in enumerate(themes):
    col, row = i%2, i//2
    tx = ML + col*(TH_COL_W+60)
    ty = y + row*(TH_ROW+TH_GAP)
    draw.ellipse([tx, ty+32, tx+16, ty+48], fill=COBALT)
    t(theme,  tx+34, ty+16, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52), fill=NAVY)
    rule(ty+76, x0=tx+34, x1=tx+TH_COL_W-10, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    wt(detail, tx+34, ty+84, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36),
       maxw=TH_COL_W-50, fill=STEEL, gap=6)

y += math.ceil(len(themes)/2)*(TH_ROW+TH_GAP) + 60

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7. CLOSING PULL-QUOTE BAND  (uses remaining vertical space)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FOOTER_Y = H - 160
BAND_Y   = FOOTER_Y - 16

remaining = BAND_Y - y - 16
if remaining >= 100:
    # Fill with a dignified tonal band + large restrained quote
    draw.rectangle([0, y, W, BAND_Y], fill="#EAE6DC")
    rule(y,       c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    rule(BAND_Y,  c=RULE_CLR, w=1)

    # Gold thin lines for elegance
    draw.rectangle([0, y,      W, y+4], fill=GOLD)
    draw.rectangle([0, BAND_Y-4, W, BAND_Y], fill=GOLD)

    # Centered quote in generous space
    q1 = "Resilience is necessary — it is not sufficient."
    q2 = "The path to inclusive growth demands deliberate action on trade, finance, and climate."
    q1_f = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 72)
    q2_f = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", 52)
    band_mid_y = (y + BAND_Y) // 2

    q1_h = th(q1, q1_f)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects — Institutional Meridian poster v3 (pristine)
A1 portrait 3508 × 4961 @ 150 dpi
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

W, H   = 3508, 4961
DPI    = 150
FONTS  = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

img  = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F4F1EA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = "#0C2847"
COBALT     = "#1A4A8A"
STEEL      = "#5A7FA8"
GOLD       = "#C4891E"
GOLD_LITE  = "#D9A84E"
LINEN      = "#F4F1EA"
OFF_WHITE  = "#EBE7DE"
DARK       = "#111827"
MID        = "#374151"
LIGHT      = "#6B7280"
RULE_CLR   = "#C5C0B5"
NAVY_CARD  = "#112B50"
COBALT_DK  = "#153D78"

# ── Font loader ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONTS, name), size)

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def tw(t, f):
    b = f.getbbox(t); return b[2]-b[0]

def th(t, f):
    b = f.getbbox(t); return b[3]-b[1]

def t(text, x, y, f, fill=DARK, anchor="lt"):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def ct(text, cx, y, f, fill=DARK):
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor="mt")

def rule(y, x0=190, x1=W-190, c=RULE_CLR, w=2):
    draw.line([(x0, y),(x1, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def rr(x0, y0, x1, y1, r=16, fill=None, outline=None, ow=2):
    if fill:    draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline: draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, outline=outline, width=ow)

def wrap(text, f, maxw):
    words, lines, cur = text.split(), [], []
    for w in words:
        test = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if tw(test, f) <= maxw: cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def wt(text, x, y, f, maxw, fill=DARK, gap=8):
    cy = y
    for ln in wrap(text, f, maxw):
        t(ln, x, cy, f, fill=fill)
        cy += th(ln, f)+gap
    return cy

def eyebrow(label, y, x=190):
    t(label.upper(), x, y, F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=GOLD)
    return y + 58

# ── Layout ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ML = 190
MR = W-190
CW = MR-ML      # 3128 px


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HDR_H = 540
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, HDR_H], fill=NAVY)
draw.rectangle([0, HDR_H, W, HDR_H+7], fill=GOLD)

t("WORLD BANK GROUP", ML, 52, F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 46), fill=GOLD)
t("GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS  ·  2025", ML, 110,
  F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 40), fill="#7A9DC0")

t("RESILIENCE", ML, 170, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 230), fill=LINEN)
t("AMID UNCERTAINTY", ML, 375, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 130), fill="#7A9DC0")

tag1 = "The global economy's strongest recovery"
tag2 = "in six decades — and the risks ahead"
t(tag1, MR, 352, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill="#7A9DC0", anchor="rt")
t(tag2, MR, 410, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

t("Annual Report · 2025", MR, 62, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 40), fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

y = HDR_H + 76

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. HEADLINE METRICS — three clean cards, no text overlap
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = eyebrow("Historic Recovery", y)
rule(y, c=GOLD, w=3); y += 38

CARD_W = (CW - 2*52) // 3
CARD_H = 320

def metric_card(cx, cy, big_num, big_sz, sub_lbl, sub_sz,
                line1, line2, bg, num_col, sub_col, txt_col):
    mid = cx + CARD_W//2
    rr(cx, cy, cx+CARD_W, cy+CARD_H, r=18, fill=bg)
    # Large number — centred in upper portion
    ct(big_num, mid, cy+18, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", big_sz), fill=num_col)
    # Sub-label — sits immediately below big num
    num_bottom = cy + 18 + big_sz - 20
    ct(sub_lbl, mid, num_bottom, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", sub_sz), fill=sub_col)
    # Hairline separator
    sep_y = num_bottom + sub_sz + 14
    rule(sep_y, x0=cx+50, x1=cx+CARD_W-50,
         c="#FFFFFF44" if bg==NAVY_CARD else "#C5C0B5", w=1)
    # Bottom labels
    ct(line1, mid, sep_y+18, F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=txt_col)
    ct(line2, mid, sep_y+70, F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38), fill=txt_col)

metric_card(ML,                    y, "6",    200, "DECADES",   72,
            "STRONGEST RECOVERY", "SINCE 1960",
            NAVY_CARD, GOLD, "#8BB0D0", "#7A9DC0")

metric_card(ML + CARD_W + 52,     y, "1.2B",  170, "YOUTH",     68,
            "ENTERING WORKING AGE", "NEXT DECADE",
            OFF_WHITE, NAVY, COBALT, LIGHT)

metric_card(ML + 2*(CARD_W+52),   y, "2030",  170, "TARGETS",   68,
            "WORLD BANK GROUP", "STRATEGIC PRIORITIES",
            COBALT_DK, LINEN, GOLD_LITE, "#8BB0D0")

y += CARD_H + 76

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. RISKS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Risks to the Outlook", y)
t("Key Downside Risks", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Downside Risks", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96)) + 16
t("Growth could falter if trade tensions escalate or financial conditions deteriorate sharply.",
  ML, y, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill=STEEL)
y += 80

risks = [
    ("01", "Trade Tensions",
     "Escalating tariffs & retaliatory measures disrupt supply chains, dampen investment."),
    ("02", "Financial Volatility",
     "Sentiment deterioration tightens financing conditions, especially for EMDEs."),
    ("03", "Inventory Correction",
     "Firms drawing down front-loaded stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
    ("04", "Climate Shocks",
     "Extreme weather threatens agricultural output & infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
]

RISK_W = (CW - 52) // 2
RISK_H = 238
RISK_GAP = 28

for i, (num, title, body) in enumerate(risks):
    col, row = i%2, i//2
    rx = ML + col*(RISK_W+52)
    ry = y + row*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP)
    bg = "#EBF0F7" if col==0 else OFF_WHITE
    rr(rx, ry, rx+RISK_W, ry+RISK_H, r=14, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([rx, ry, rx+7, ry+RISK_H], fill=GOLD)
    t(num,   rx+28, ry+16, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf",  40), fill=GOLD)
    t(title, rx+28, ry+64, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",   60), fill=NAVY)
    wt(body, rx+28, ry+136, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 46),
       maxw=RISK_W-58, fill=MID, gap=8)

y += 2*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. POLICY ACTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Policy Framework", y)
t("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 40

policies = [
    ("Trade",      ["Multilateral environment", "Diversify trade partners"]),
    ("Finance",    ["Ease EMDE constraints", "Macro policy frameworks"]),
    ("Climate",    ["Scale risk mitigation", "Resilient infrastructure"]),
    ("Investment", ["Catalyze private capital", "Remove bottlenecks"]),
    ("Jobs",       ["Cross-border mobility", "Skills development"]),
]

POL_W = (CW - 4*20) // 5
POL_H = 256

for i, (area, actions) in enumerate(policies):
    px = ML + i*(POL_W+20)
    py = y
    bg = "#E2EBF5" if i%2==0 else OFF_WHITE
    tc = NAVY if i%2==0 else COBALT
    rr(px, py, px+POL_W, py+POL_H, r=12, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([px, py, px+POL_W, py+6], fill=COBALT)
    ct(area, px+POL_W//2, py+18, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56), fill=tc)
    rule(py+86, x0=px+16, x1=px+POL_W-16, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    cy = py+100
    for ln in actions:
        ct(ln, px+POL_W//2, cy, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 40), fill=MID)
        cy += 54

y += POL_H + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. WORLD BANK 2030 TARGETS — fixed layout: name | value | description, no overlap
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("World Bank Group 2030 Targets", y)
t("Strategic Priorities", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Strategic Priorities", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 36

targets = [
    ("Health Services",  "1.5B",  "people — quality, affordable health services"),
    ("Mission 300",      "300M",  "people in Sub-Saharan Africa — electricity access"),
    ("AgriConnect",      "300M",  "farmers — moving up the agricultural value chain"),
    ("Women's Capital",  "80M",   "women & women-led businesses — access to capital"),
    ("Water Forward",    "1B+",   "people — improved water security · 400M WBG commitment"),
]

# Column x-positions (non-overlapping)
INIT_X    = ML + 24    # initiative name
INIT_MAXW = 340
NUM_X     = ML + 420   # big number starts here
NUM_MAXW  = 290        # max width of number glyph before desc starts
DESC_X    = ML + 730   # description column
DESC_MAXW = MR - DESC_X - 20

TGT_ROW = 112
TGT_GAP = 10

for i, (init, val, desc) in enumerate(targets):
    ty = y + i*(TGT_ROW+TGT_GAP)
    if i%2==0:
        draw.rectangle([ML, ty-4, MR, ty+TGT_ROW+4], fill=OFF_WHITE)
    draw.rectangle([ML, ty, ML+6, ty+TGT_ROW-4], fill=COBALT)

    # Initiative name — vertically centred in row
    t(init, INIT_X, ty + (TGT_ROW - th(init, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 50)))//2,
      F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 50), fill=NAVY)

    # Value number
    t(val, NUM_X, ty + (TGT_ROW - th(val, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)))//2,
      F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86), fill=GOLD)

    # Description
    t(desc, DESC_X, ty + (TGT_ROW - th(desc, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 44)))//2,
      F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=MID)

y += len(targets)*(TGT_ROW+TGT_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. RESEARCH THEMES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Analytical Depth", y)
t("Key Research Themes", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Research Themes", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 36

themes = [
    ("Fiscal Policy",
     "Rebuilding fiscal space · Fiscal rules · Small-state challenges"),
    ("Trade & Supply Chains",
     "High trade costs — causes & remedies · COVID-19 supply chain impact"),
    ("Commodity Markets",
     "Price cycle drivers · Russia-Ukraine energy implications"),
    ("Financial Spillovers",
     "Rising U.S. interest rates · Rapid debt buildup dynamics"),
    ("Pandemic Economics",
     "COVID-19 income inequality · Regional macroeconomic implications"),
]

TH_COL_W = (CW-60)//2
TH_ROW   = 124
TH_GAP   = 12

for i, (theme, detail) in enumerate(themes):
    col, row = i%2, i//2
    tx = ML + col*(TH_COL_W+60)
    ty = y + row*(TH_ROW+TH_GAP)
    draw.ellipse([tx, ty+32, tx+16, ty+48], fill=COBALT)
    t(theme,  tx+34, ty+16, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52), fill=NAVY)
    rule(ty+76, x0=tx+34, x1=tx+TH_COL_W-10, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    wt(detail, tx+34, ty+84, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36),
       maxw=TH_COL_W-50, fill=STEEL, gap=6)

y += math.ceil(len(themes)/2)*(TH_ROW+TH_GAP) + 60

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7. CLOSING PULL-QUOTE BAND  (uses remaining vertical space)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FOOTER_Y = H - 160
BAND_Y   = FOOTER_Y - 16

remaining = BAND_Y - y - 16
if remaining >= 100:
    # Fill with a dignified tonal band + large restrained quote
    draw.rectangle([0, y, W, BAND_Y], fill="#EAE6DC")
    rule(y,       c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    rule(BAND_Y,  c=RULE_CLR, w=1)

    # Gold thin lines for elegance
    draw.rectangle([0, y,      W, y+4], fill=GOLD)
    draw.rectangle([0, BAND_Y-4, W, BAND_Y], fill=GOLD)

    # Centered quote in generous space
    q1 = "Resilience is necessary — it is not sufficient."
    q2 = "The path to inclusive growth demands deliberate action on trade, finance, and climate."
    q1_f = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 72)
    q2_f = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", 52)

    q1_h = th(q1, q1_f)
    q2_h = th(q2, q2_f)
    total_text_h = q1_h + 28 + q2_h

    ct(q1, W//2, band_mid_y - total_text_h//2, q1_f, fill=NAVY)
    # em-dash rule
    rule(band_mid_y - total_text_h//2 + q1_h + 14,
         x0=W//2-140, x1=W//2+140, c=GOLD, w=2)
    ct(q2, W//2, band_mid_y - total_text_h//2 + q1_h + 28, q2_f, fill=STEEL)

    t(title, rx+28, ry+64, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",   60), fill=NAVY)
    wt(body, rx+28, ry+136, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 46),
       maxw=RISK_W-60, fill=MID, gap=8)

y += 2*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP) + 72

rule(y); y += 44

policies = [

]

POL_W = (CW - 4*20) // 5
POL_H = 256

for i, (area, actions) in enumerate(policies):

    bg = "#E2EBF5" if i%2==0 else OFF_WHITE
    tc = NAVY if i%2==0 else COBALT
    rr(px, py, px+POL_W, py+POL_H, r=12, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([px, py, px+POL_W, py+6], fill=COBALT)
    ct(area, px+POL_W//2, py+18, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56), fill=tc)
    rule(py+86, x0=px+16, x1=px+POL_W-16, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)

    for ln in actions:

        cy += 54

y += POL_H + 72

targets = [

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects — Institutional Meridian v4 (final, pristine)
A1 portrait 3508 × 4961 @ 150 dpi
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

W, H   = 3508, 4961
DPI    = 150
FONTS  = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

img  = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F4F1EA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = "#0C2847"
COBALT     = "#1A4A8A"
STEEL      = "#5A7FA8"
GOLD       = "#C4891E"
GOLD_LITE  = "#D9A84E"
LINEN      = "#F4F1EA"
OFF_WHITE  = "#EBE7DE"
DARK       = "#111827"
MID        = "#374151"
LIGHT      = "#6B7280"
RULE_CLR   = "#C5C0B5"
NAVY_CARD  = "#112B50"
COBALT_DK  = "#153D78"

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONTS, name), size)

def tw(t, f):
    b = f.getbbox(t); return b[2]-b[0]

def th(t, f):
    b = f.getbbox(t); return b[3]-b[1]

def t(text, x, y, f, fill=DARK, anchor="lt"):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def ct(text, cx, y, f, fill=DARK):
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor="mt")

def rule(y, x0=190, x1=W-190, c=RULE_CLR, w=2):
    draw.line([(x0, y),(x1, y)], fill=c, width=w)

def rr(x0, y0, x1, y1, r=16, fill=None, outline=None, ow=2):
    if fill:    draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline: draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, outline=outline, width=ow)

def wrap(text, f, maxw):
    words, lines, cur = text.split(), [], []
    for w in words:
        test = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if tw(test, f) <= maxw: cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def wt(text, x, y, f, maxw, fill=DARK, gap=8):
    cy = y
    for ln in wrap(text, f, maxw):
        t(ln, x, cy, f, fill=fill)
        cy += th(ln, f)+gap
    return cy

def eyebrow(label, y, x=190):
    t(label.upper(), x, y, F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 44), fill=GOLD)
    return y + 58

ML = 190
MR = W-190
CW = MR-ML      # 3128 px


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HDR_H = 540
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, HDR_H], fill=NAVY)
draw.rectangle([0, HDR_H, W, HDR_H+7], fill=GOLD)

t("WORLD BANK GROUP", ML, 52, F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 46), fill=GOLD)
t("GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS  ·  2025", ML, 110,
  F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 40), fill="#7A9DC0")

t("RESILIENCE", ML, 170, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 232), fill=LINEN)
t("AMID UNCERTAINTY", ML, 378, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 132), fill="#7A9DC0")

t("Annual Report · 2025", MR, 62, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 40), fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")
tag1 = "The global economy's strongest recovery"
tag2 = "in six decades — and the risks ahead"
t(tag1, MR, 350, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill="#7A9DC0", anchor="rt")
t(tag2, MR, 408, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

y = HDR_H + 76

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. HEADLINE METRICS — three clean cards
#    Each card: big number, sub-label, then a hairline, then two bottom lines
#    All sizes and positions chosen so nothing crowds.
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = eyebrow("Historic Recovery", y)
rule(y, c=GOLD, w=3); y += 38

CARD_W = (CW - 2*52) // 3
CARD_H = 340

# Card layout constants
BIG_SZ   = 194    # large numeral font size
SUB_SZ   = 64     # sub-label font size
LBL_SZ   = 44     # bottom caption font size
BIG_TOP  = 14     # top padding for numeral
# The numeral takes ~BIG_SZ px height; sub-label sits 4px below that
# then a hairline; then two labels fit in remaining space

def metric_card(cx, cy, big_num, sub_lbl,
                lbl1, lbl2,
                bg, num_col, sub_col, lbl_col):
    mid = cx + CARD_W//2
    rr(cx, cy, cx+CARD_W, cy+CARD_H, r=18, fill=bg)

    # Big numeral
    num_y = cy + BIG_TOP
    ct(big_num, mid, num_y, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", BIG_SZ), fill=num_col)

    # Sub-label (e.g. "DECADES")
    sub_y = num_y + BIG_SZ - 10
    ct(sub_lbl, mid, sub_y, F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", SUB_SZ), fill=sub_col)

    # Hairline
    sep_y = sub_y + SUB_SZ + 12
    rule(sep_y, x0=cx+50, x1=cx+CARD_W-50,
         c="#FFFFFF55" if bg==NAVY_CARD else RULE_CLR, w=1)

    # Two caption lines
    lbl1_y = sep_y + 16
    lbl2_y = lbl1_y + LBL_SZ + 10
    ct(lbl1, mid, lbl1_y, F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", LBL_SZ), fill=lbl_col)
    ct(lbl2, mid, lbl2_y, F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38),      fill=lbl_col)

metric_card(ML,                   y,
            "6",     "DECADES",
            "STRONGEST RECOVERY", "SINCE 1960",
            NAVY_CARD, GOLD, "#8BB0D0", "#7A9DC0")

metric_card(ML + CARD_W + 52,    y,
            "1.2B",  "YOUTH",
            "ENTERING WORKING AGE", "NEXT DECADE",
            OFF_WHITE, NAVY, COBALT, LIGHT)

metric_card(ML + 2*(CARD_W+52),  y,
            "2030",  "TARGETS",
            "WORLD BANK GROUP", "STRATEGIC PRIORITIES",
            COBALT_DK, LINEN, GOLD_LITE, "#8BB0D0")

y += CARD_H + 76

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. RISKS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Risks to the Outlook", y)
t("Key Downside Risks", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Downside Risks", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96)) + 16
t("Growth could falter if trade tensions escalate or financial conditions deteriorate sharply.",
  ML, y, F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf", 52), fill=STEEL)
y += 80

risks = [
    ("01", "Trade Tensions",
     "Escalating tariffs & retaliatory measures disrupt supply chains, dampen investment."),
    ("02", "Financial Volatility",
     "Sentiment deterioration tightens financing conditions, especially for EMDEs."),
    ("03", "Inventory Correction",
     "Firms drawing down front-loaded stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
    ("04", "Climate Shocks",
     "Extreme weather threatens agricultural output & infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
]

RISK_W = (CW - 52) // 2
RISK_H = 238
RISK_GAP = 28

for i, (num, title, body) in enumerate(risks):
    col, row = i%2, i//2
    rx = ML + col*(RISK_W+52)
    ry = y + row*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP)
    bg = "#EBF0F7" if col==0 else OFF_WHITE
    rr(rx, ry, rx+RISK_W, ry+RISK_H, r=14, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([rx, ry, rx+7, ry+RISK_H], fill=GOLD)
    t(num,   rx+28, ry+16, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf",  40), fill=GOLD)
    t(title, rx+28, ry+64, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",   60), fill=NAVY)
    wt(body, rx+28, ry+136, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 46),
       maxw=RISK_W-60, fill=MID, gap=8)

y += 2*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. POLICY ACTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Policy Framework", y)
t("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 40

policies = [
    ("Trade",      ["Multilateral environment", "Diversify trade partners"]),
    ("Finance",    ["Ease EMDE constraints", "Macro policy frameworks"]),
    ("Climate",    ["Scale risk mitigation", "Resilient infrastructure"]),
    ("Investment", ["Catalyze private capital", "Remove bottlenecks"]),
    ("Jobs",       ["Cross-border mobility", "Skills development"]),
]

POL_W = (CW - 4*20) // 5
POL_H = 256

for i, (area, actions) in enumerate(policies):
    px = ML + i*(POL_W+20)
    py = y
    bg = "#E2EBF5" if i%2==0 else OFF_WHITE
    tc = NAVY if i%2==0 else COBALT
    rr(px, py, px+POL_W, py+POL_H, r=12, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([px, py, px+POL_W, py+6], fill=COBALT)
    ct(area, px+POL_W//2, py+18, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56), fill=tc)
    rule(py+86, x0=px+16, x1=px+POL_W-16, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    cy = py+100
    for ln in actions:
        ct(ln, px+POL_W//2, cy, F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 40), fill=MID)
        cy += 54

y += POL_H + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. WORLD BANK 2030 STRATEGIC PRIORITIES
#    Layout: fixed three-column grid so name / number / desc never overlap.
#    Column widths measured from content, padded generously.
#    INIT_W  = 370 → initiative name column
#    NUM_W   = 310 → number column (BigShoulders bold 86pt max ~280px for "300M")
#    REST    = remaining → description
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("World Bank Group 2030 Targets", y)
t("Strategic Priorities", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Strategic Priorities", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 36

targets = [
    ("Health Services", "1.5B",
     "people — quality, affordable health services"),
    ("Mission 300",     "300M",
     "people in Sub-Saharan Africa — electricity access"),
    ("AgriConnect",     "300M",
     "farmers — moving up the agricultural value chain"),
    ("Women's Capital", "80M",
     "women & women-led businesses — access to capital"),
    ("Water Forward",   "1B+",
     "people — improved water security  ·  400M WBG commitment"),
]

# Column geometry
INIT_X   = ML + 24        # initiative name (left-aligned)
INIT_END = ML + 380        # initiative column right edge
NUM_X    = INIT_END + 28   # number column start
NUM_END  = NUM_X + 290     # number column right edge (~86pt "300M" ≈ 270px)
DESC_X   = NUM_END + 28    # description start
DESC_END = MR - 16

TGT_H    = 116
TGT_GAP  = 10
TGT_F_INIT = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf",   50)
TGT_F_NUM  = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 84)
TGT_F_DESC = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 46)

for i, (init, val, desc) in enumerate(targets):
    ty = y + i*(TGT_H+TGT_GAP)
    if i%2==0:
        draw.rectangle([ML, ty-4, MR, ty+TGT_H+4], fill=OFF_WHITE)
    draw.rectangle([ML, ty, ML+6, ty+TGT_H-4], fill=COBALT)

    # Vertically centre each text element in the row
    init_h = th(init, TGT_F_INIT)
    num_h  = th(val,  TGT_F_NUM)
    desc_h = th(desc, TGT_F_DESC)

    t(init, INIT_X, ty + (TGT_H-init_h)//2, TGT_F_INIT, fill=NAVY)
    t(val,  NUM_X,  ty + (TGT_H-num_h)//2,  TGT_F_NUM,  fill=GOLD)
    t(desc, DESC_X, ty + (TGT_H-desc_h)//2, TGT_F_DESC, fill=MID)

y += len(targets)*(TGT_H+TGT_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. RESEARCH THEMES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Analytical Depth", y)
t("Key Research Themes", ML, y, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80), fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Research Themes", F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)) + 36

themes = [
    ("Fiscal Policy",
     "Rebuilding fiscal space · Fiscal rules · Small-state challenges"),
    ("Trade & Supply Chains",
     "High trade costs — causes & remedies · COVID-19 supply chain impact"),
    ("Commodity Markets",
     "Price cycle drivers · Russia-Ukraine energy implications"),
    ("Financial Spillovers",
     "Rising U.S. interest rates · Rapid debt buildup dynamics"),
    ("Pandemic Economics",
     "COVID-19 income inequality · Regional macroeconomic implications"),
]

TH_COL_W = (CW-60)//2
TH_ROW   = 122
TH_GAP   = 14

for i, (theme, detail) in enumerate(themes):
    col, row = i%2, i//2
    tx = ML + col*(TH_COL_W+60)
    ty = y + row*(TH_ROW+TH_GAP)
    draw.ellipse([tx, ty+30, tx+16, ty+46], fill=COBALT)
    t(theme,  tx+34, ty+14, F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52), fill=NAVY)
    rule(ty+74, x0=tx+34, x1=tx+TH_COL_W-10, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    wt(detail, tx+34, ty+82, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36),
       maxw=TH_COL_W-50, fill=STEEL, gap=6)

y += math.ceil(len(themes)/2)*(TH_ROW+TH_GAP) + 64

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7. CLOSING PULL-QUOTE
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FOOTER_Y = H - 160
BAND_Y   = FOOTER_Y - 16
remaining = BAND_Y - y - 16

if remaining >= 80:
    draw.rectangle([0, y, W, BAND_Y], fill="#EAE6DC")
    draw.rectangle([0, y, W, y+4],         fill=GOLD)
    draw.rectangle([0, BAND_Y-4, W, BAND_Y], fill=GOLD)

    q1 = "Resilience is necessary — it is not sufficient."
    q2 = "The path to inclusive growth demands deliberate action on trade, finance, and climate."
    q1_f = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",  72)
    q2_f = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", 50)

    q1_h = th(q1, q1_f)
    q2_h = th(q2, q2_f)
    total = q1_h + 28 + q2_h
    band_mid = (y + BAND_Y)//2

    ct(q1, W//2, band_mid - total//2,             q1_f, fill=NAVY)
    rule(  band_mid - total//2 + q1_h + 14,
           x0=W//2-120, x1=W//2+120, c=GOLD, w=2)
    ct(q2, W//2, band_mid - total//2 + q1_h + 28, q2_f, fill=STEEL)

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 8. FOOTER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
draw.rectangle([0, FOOTER_Y, W, H], fill=NAVY)
draw.rectangle([0, FOOTER_Y, W, FOOTER_Y+6], fill=GOLD)

fm = (FOOTER_Y + H)//2
t("World Bank Group  ·  worldbank.org/gep",
  ML, fm-32, F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 42), fill="#7A9DC0")
t("© 2025 The World Bank  ·  Global Economic Prospects",
  ML, fm+14, F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38), fill="#5A80A8")
t("GEP · 2025", MR, fm-10, F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 52), fill=GOLD, anchor="rt")

# ── Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
img.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(DPI, DPI))
print(f"Saved {out}  {W}×{H}@{DPI}dpi  remaining={remaining}px")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects — Institutional Meridian v5 (FINAL PRISTINE)
A1 portrait 3508 × 4961 @ 150 dpi
All column positions are pixel-exact; no text can overlap.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

W, H   = 3508, 4961
DPI    = 150
FONTS  = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

img  = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F4F1EA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = "#0C2847"
COBALT     = "#1A4A8A"
STEEL      = "#5A7FA8"
GOLD       = "#C4891E"
GOLD_LITE  = "#D9A84E"
LINEN      = "#F4F1EA"
OFF_WHITE  = "#EBE7DE"
DARK       = "#111827"
MID        = "#374151"
LIGHT      = "#6B7280"
RULE_CLR   = "#C5C0B5"
NAVY_CARD  = "#112B50"
COBALT_DK  = "#153D78"

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONTS, name), size)

# Pre-load fonts once
f_arsenal44 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_arsenal46 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_arsenal52 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 52)
f_bigs232   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 232)
f_bigs132   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 132)
f_bigs194   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 194)
f_bigs64    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)
f_bigs86    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_ws80      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
f_ws96      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_ws60      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 60)
f_ws56      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56)
f_ws50      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_ws52      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52)
f_wr46      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_wr44      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_wr40      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_is52      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 52)
f_is_it52   = F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf",  52)
f_is44      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_is40      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_is38      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
f_dm42      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_dm40      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_dm36      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_ibm72     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 72)
f_ibm50     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", 50)

def tw(txt, f):
    b = f.getbbox(txt); return b[2]-b[0]

def th(txt, f):
    b = f.getbbox(txt); return b[3]-b[1]

def T(text, x, y, f, fill=DARK, anchor="lt"):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def CT(text, cx, y, f, fill=DARK):
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor="mt")

def rule(y, x0=190, x1=W-190, c=RULE_CLR, w=2):
    draw.line([(x0,y),(x1,y)], fill=c, width=w)

def rr(x0,y0,x1,y1, r=16, fill=None, outline=None, ow=2):
    if fill:    draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline: draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, outline=outline, width=ow)

def wrap(text, f, maxw):
    words, lines, cur = text.split(), [], []
    for w in words:
        test = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if tw(test,f) <= maxw: cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def WT(text, x, y, f, maxw, fill=DARK, gap=8):
    cy = y
    for ln in wrap(text,f,maxw):
        T(ln,x,cy,f,fill=fill)
        cy += th(ln,f)+gap
    return cy

def eyebrow(label, y, x=190):
    T(label.upper(), x, y, f_arsenal44, fill=GOLD)
    return y + 58

MR = W-190
CW = MR-ML    # 3128 px

T("AMID UNCERTAINTY", ML, 385, f_bigs132, fill="#7A9DC0")

#    big numeral: 194pt → renders ~184px h
#    sub-label:    64pt → ~58px h

y = eyebrow("Historic Recovery", y)
rule(y, c=GOLD, w=3); y += 40

CARD_H = 370

def metric_card(cx, cy, big, sub, l1, l2, bg, ncol, scol, lcol):
    mid = cx + CARD_W//2
    rr(cx, cy, cx+CARD_W, cy+CARD_H, r=20, fill=bg)
    # big numeral

    # sub label
    CT(sub, mid, cy+14+184, f_bigs64, fill=scol)
    # separator
    sep = cy + 14 + 184 + 62
    rule(sep, x0=cx+50, x1=cx+CARD_W-50,
         c="#FFFFFF55" if bg==NAVY_CARD else RULE_CLR, w=1)
    # captions
    CT(l1, mid, sep+16, f_is44,           fill=lcol)
    CT(l2, mid, sep+72, f_is38,           fill=lcol)

metric_card(ML,                   y, "6",    "DECADES",
            "STRONGEST RECOVERY", "SINCE 1960",
            NAVY_CARD, GOLD, "#8BB0D0", "#7A9DC0")

metric_card(ML+CARD_W+52,        y, "1.2B",  "YOUTH",
            "ENTERING WORKING AGE", "NEXT DECADE",
            OFF_WHITE, NAVY, COBALT, LIGHT)

metric_card(ML+2*(CARD_W+52),    y, "2030",  "TARGETS",
            "WORLD BANK GROUP", "STRATEGIC PRIORITIES",
            COBALT_DK, LINEN, GOLD_LITE, "#8BB0D0")

y += CARD_H + 78

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. RISKS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Risks to the Outlook", y)
T("Key Downside Risks", ML, y, f_ws96, fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Downside Risks", f_ws96) + 16
T("Growth could falter if trade tensions escalate or financial conditions deteriorate sharply.",
  ML, y, f_is_it52, fill=STEEL)
y += 80

risks = [
    ("01","Trade Tensions",
     "Escalating tariffs & retaliatory measures disrupt supply chains, dampen investment."),
    ("02","Financial Volatility",
     "Sentiment deterioration tightens financing conditions, especially for EMDEs."),
    ("03","Inventory Correction",
     "Firms drawing down front-loaded stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
    ("04","Climate Shocks",
     "Extreme weather threatens agricultural output & infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
]

RISK_W = (CW-52)//2
RISK_H = 240
RISK_GAP = 28

for i,(num,title,body) in enumerate(risks):
    col,row = i%2,i//2
    rx = ML + col*(RISK_W+52)
    ry = y + row*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP)
    bg = "#EBF0F7" if col==0 else OFF_WHITE
    rr(rx,ry,rx+RISK_W,ry+RISK_H, r=14, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([rx,ry,rx+7,ry+RISK_H], fill=GOLD)
    T(num,   rx+28, ry+16, f_dm40, fill=GOLD)
    T(title, rx+28, ry+64, f_ws60, fill=NAVY)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects — Institutional Meridian v5 (FINAL PRISTINE)
A1 portrait 3508 × 4961 @ 150 dpi
All column positions are pixel-exact; no text can overlap.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

W, H   = 3508, 4961
DPI    = 150
FONTS  = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

img  = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F4F1EA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = "#0C2847"
COBALT     = "#1A4A8A"
STEEL      = "#5A7FA8"
GOLD       = "#C4891E"
GOLD_LITE  = "#D9A84E"
LINEN      = "#F4F1EA"
OFF_WHITE  = "#EBE7DE"
DARK       = "#111827"
MID        = "#374151"
LIGHT      = "#6B7280"
RULE_CLR   = "#C5C0B5"
NAVY_CARD  = "#112B50"
COBALT_DK  = "#153D78"

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONTS, name), size)

# Pre-load fonts once
f_arsenal44 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_arsenal46 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_arsenal52 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 52)
f_bigs232   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 232)
f_bigs132   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 132)
f_bigs194   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 194)
f_bigs64    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)
f_bigs86    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_ws80      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
f_ws96      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_ws60      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 60)
f_ws56      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56)
f_ws50      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_ws52      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52)
f_wr46      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_wr44      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_wr40      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_is52      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 52)
f_is_it52   = F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf",  52)
f_is44      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_is40      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_is38      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
f_dm42      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_dm40      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_dm36      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_ibm72     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 72)
f_ibm50     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", 50)

def tw(txt, f):
    b = f.getbbox(txt); return b[2]-b[0]

def th(txt, f):
    b = f.getbbox(txt); return b[3]-b[1]

def T(text, x, y, f, fill=DARK, anchor="lt"):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def CT(text, cx, y, f, fill=DARK):
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor="mt")

def rule(y, x0=190, x1=W-190, c=RULE_CLR, w=2):
    draw.line([(x0,y),(x1,y)], fill=c, width=w)

def rr(x0,y0,x1,y1, r=16, fill=None, outline=None, ow=2):
    if fill:    draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline: draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, outline=outline, width=ow)

def wrap(text, f, maxw):
    words, lines, cur = text.split(), [], []
    for w in words:
        test = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if tw(test,f) <= maxw: cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def WT(text, x, y, f, maxw, fill=DARK, gap=8):
    cy = y
    for ln in wrap(text,f,maxw):
        T(ln,x,cy,f,fill=fill)
        cy += th(ln,f)+gap
    return cy

def eyebrow(label, y, x=190):
    T(label.upper(), x, y, f_arsenal44, fill=GOLD)
    return y + 58

ML = 190
MR = W-190
CW = MR-ML    # 3128 px

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HDR_H = 548
draw.rectangle([0,0,W,HDR_H], fill=NAVY)
draw.rectangle([0,HDR_H,W,HDR_H+7], fill=GOLD)

T("WORLD BANK GROUP", ML, 52,  f_arsenal46, fill=GOLD)
T("GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS  ·  2025", ML, 112, f_arsenal40 := F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf",40), fill="#7A9DC0")

T("RESILIENCE",       ML, 172, f_bigs232, fill=LINEN)
T("AMID UNCERTAINTY", ML, 385, f_bigs132, fill="#7A9DC0")

T("Annual Report · 2025", MR, 62, f_dm40, fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

tag1 = "The global economy's strongest recovery"
tag2 = "in six decades — and the risks ahead"
T(tag1, MR, 356, f_is_it52, fill="#7A9DC0", anchor="rt")
T(tag2, MR, 416, f_is_it52, fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

y = HDR_H + 78

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. METRIC TRIO
#    Heights computed so nothing crowds:
#    big numeral: 194pt → renders ~184px h
#    sub-label:    64pt → ~58px h
#    separator + two captions: 12 + 16 + 44 + 10 + 38 = 120px
#    total content = 184+58+120 = 362 → CARD_H = 370
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = eyebrow("Historic Recovery", y)
rule(y, c=GOLD, w=3); y += 40

CARD_W = (CW - 2*52) // 3
CARD_H = 370

def metric_card(cx, cy, big, sub, l1, l2, bg, ncol, scol, lcol):
    mid = cx + CARD_W//2
    rr(cx, cy, cx+CARD_W, cy+CARD_H, r=20, fill=bg)
    # big numeral
    CT(big, mid, cy+14, f_bigs194, fill=ncol)
    # sub label
    CT(sub, mid, cy+14+184, f_bigs64, fill=scol)
    # separator
    sep = cy + 14 + 184 + 62
    rule(sep, x0=cx+50, x1=cx+CARD_W-50,
         c="#FFFFFF55" if bg==NAVY_CARD else RULE_CLR, w=1)
    # captions
    CT(l1, mid, sep+16, f_is44,           fill=lcol)
    CT(l2, mid, sep+72, f_is38,           fill=lcol)

metric_card(ML,                   y, "6",    "DECADES",
            "STRONGEST RECOVERY", "SINCE 1960",
            NAVY_CARD, GOLD, "#8BB0D0", "#7A9DC0")

metric_card(ML+CARD_W+52,        y, "1.2B",  "YOUTH",
            "ENTERING WORKING AGE", "NEXT DECADE",
            OFF_WHITE, NAVY, COBALT, LIGHT)

metric_card(ML+2*(CARD_W+52),    y, "2030",  "TARGETS",
            "WORLD BANK GROUP", "STRATEGIC PRIORITIES",
            COBALT_DK, LINEN, GOLD_LITE, "#8BB0D0")

y += CARD_H + 78

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. RISKS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Risks to the Outlook", y)
T("Key Downside Risks", ML, y, f_ws96, fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Downside Risks", f_ws96) + 16
T("Growth could falter if trade tensions escalate or financial conditions deteriorate sharply.",
  ML, y, f_is_it52, fill=STEEL)
y += 80

risks = [
    ("01","Trade Tensions",
     "Escalating tariffs & retaliatory measures disrupt supply chains, dampen investment."),
    ("02","Financial Volatility",
     "Sentiment deterioration tightens financing conditions, especially for EMDEs."),
    ("03","Inventory Correction",
     "Firms drawing down front-loaded stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
    ("04","Climate Shocks",
     "Extreme weather threatens agricultural output & infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
]

RISK_W = (CW-52)//2
RISK_H = 240
RISK_GAP = 28

for i,(num,title,body) in enumerate(risks):
    col,row = i%2,i//2
    rx = ML + col*(RISK_W+52)
    ry = y + row*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP)
    bg = "#EBF0F7" if col==0 else OFF_WHITE
    rr(rx,ry,rx+RISK_W,ry+RISK_H, r=14, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([rx,ry,rx+7,ry+RISK_H], fill=GOLD)
    T(num,   rx+28, ry+16, f_dm40, fill=GOLD)
    T(title, rx+28, ry+64, f_ws60, fill=NAVY)
    WT(body, rx+28, ry+138, f_wr46, maxw=RISK_W-62, fill=MID, gap=8)

y += 2*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. POLICY ACTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Policy Framework", y)
T("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", ML, y, f_ws80, fill=NAVY)
y += th("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", f_ws80) + 42

policies = [
    ("Trade",      ["Multilateral environment","Diversify trade partners"]),
    ("Finance",    ["Ease EMDE constraints","Macro policy frameworks"]),
    ("Climate",    ["Scale risk mitigation","Resilient infrastructure"]),
    ("Investment", ["Catalyze private capital","Remove bottlenecks"]),
    ("Jobs",       ["Cross-border mobility","Skills development"]),
]

POL_W = (CW-4*20)//5
POL_H = 258

for i,(area,actions) in enumerate(policies):
    px = ML + i*(POL_W+20)
    py = y
    bg = "#E2EBF5" if i%2==0 else OFF_WHITE
    tc = NAVY if i%2==0 else COBALT
    rr(px,py,px+POL_W,py+POL_H, r=12, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([px,py,px+POL_W,py+6], fill=COBALT)
    CT(area,px+POL_W//2,py+18,f_ws56,fill=tc)
    rule(py+88, x0=px+16, x1=px+POL_W-16, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    cy = py+102
    for ln in actions:
        CT(ln,px+POL_W//2,cy,f_wr40,fill=MID)
        cy += 56

y += POL_H + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. STRATEGIC PRIORITIES
#    Three columns with MEASURED gap between name and number.
#    "Women's Capital" in WorkSans-Bold 50pt ≈ 468px wide → must end by ML+490
#    Number column: BigShoulders-Bold 86pt, "300M" ≈ 260px → fits in 300px
#    Columns:
#      INIT: ML+24 → ML+490  (466px wide, enough for longest name)
#      GAP1: 28px
#      NUM:  ML+518 → ML+818 (300px)
#      GAP2: 28px
#      DESC: ML+846 → MR-16
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("World Bank Group 2030 Targets", y)
T("Strategic Priorities", ML, y, f_ws80, fill=NAVY)
y += th("Strategic Priorities", f_ws80) + 36

targets = [
    ("Health Services", "1.5B",  "people — quality, affordable health services"),
    ("Mission 300",     "300M",  "people in Sub-Saharan Africa — electricity access"),
    ("AgriConnect",     "300M",  "farmers — moving up the agricultural value chain"),
    ("Women's Capital", "80M",   "women & women-led businesses — access to capital"),
    ("Water Forward",   "1B+",   "people — improved water security  ·  400M WBG commitment"),
]

INIT_X  = ML + 24
NUM_X   = ML + 518    # number column start
DESC_X  = ML + 846    # description column start
DESC_W  = MR - DESC_X - 16

TGT_H   = 118
TGT_GAP = 10

for i,(init,val,desc) in enumerate(targets):
    ty = y + i*(TGT_H+TGT_GAP)
    if i%2==0:
        draw.rectangle([ML,ty-4,MR,ty+TGT_H+4], fill=OFF_WHITE)
    draw.rectangle([ML,ty,ML+6,ty+TGT_H-4], fill=COBALT)

    init_h = th(init, f_ws50)
    num_h  = th(val,  f_bigs86)
    desc_h = th(desc, f_wr44)

    T(init, INIT_X, ty+(TGT_H-init_h)//2, f_ws50, fill=NAVY)
    T(val,  NUM_X,  ty+(TGT_H-num_h)//2,  f_bigs86, fill=GOLD)
    T(desc, DESC_X, ty+(TGT_H-desc_h)//2, f_wr44, fill=MID)

y += len(targets)*(TGT_H+TGT_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. RESEARCH THEMES
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Analytical Depth", y)
T("Key Research Themes", ML, y, f_ws80, fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Research Themes", f_ws80) + 36

themes = [
    ("Fiscal Policy",
     "Rebuilding fiscal space · Fiscal rules · Small-state challenges"),
    ("Trade & Supply Chains",
     "High trade costs — causes & remedies · COVID-19 supply chain impact"),
    ("Commodity Markets",
     "Price cycle drivers · Russia-Ukraine energy implications"),
    ("Financial Spillovers",
     "Rising U.S. interest rates · Rapid debt buildup dynamics"),
    ("Pandemic Economics",
     "COVID-19 income inequality · Regional macroeconomic implications"),
]

TH_COL_W = (CW-60)//2
TH_ROW   = 124
TH_GAP   = 14

for i,(theme,detail) in enumerate(themes):
    col,row = i%2,i//2
    tx = ML + col*(TH_COL_W+60)
    ty = y + row*(TH_ROW+TH_GAP)
    draw.ellipse([tx,ty+32,tx+16,ty+48], fill=COBALT)
    T(theme, tx+34, ty+16, f_ws52, fill=NAVY)
    rule(ty+76, x0=tx+34, x1=tx+TH_COL_W-10, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    WT(detail, tx+34, ty+84, f_dm36, maxw=TH_COL_W-50, fill=STEEL, gap=6)

y += math.ceil(len(themes)/2)*(TH_ROW+TH_GAP) + 64

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7. CLOSING PULL-QUOTE BAND
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
FOOTER_Y = H-162
BAND_Y   = FOOTER_Y-16
rem = BAND_Y - y - 16

if rem >= 80:
    draw.rectangle([0,y,W,BAND_Y], fill="#EAE6DC")
    draw.rectangle([0,y,W,y+4],           fill=GOLD)
    draw.rectangle([0,BAND_Y-4,W,BAND_Y], fill=GOLD)

    q1 = "Resilience is necessary — it is not sufficient."
    q2 = "The path to inclusive growth demands deliberate action on trade, finance, and climate."
    q1h = th(q1, f_ibm72)
    q2h = th(q2, f_ibm50)
    total = q1h + 28 + q2h
    bm = (y+BAND_Y)//2

    CT(q1, W//2, bm-total//2,         f_ibm72, fill=NAVY)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Global Economic Prospects — Institutional Meridian v5 (FINAL PRISTINE)
A1 portrait 3508 × 4961 @ 150 dpi
All column positions are pixel-exact; no text can overlap.
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

W, H   = 3508, 4961
DPI    = 150
FONTS  = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"

img  = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), "#F4F1EA")
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
NAVY       = "#0C2847"
COBALT     = "#1A4A8A"
STEEL      = "#5A7FA8"
GOLD       = "#C4891E"
GOLD_LITE  = "#D9A84E"
LINEN      = "#F4F1EA"
OFF_WHITE  = "#EBE7DE"
DARK       = "#111827"
MID        = "#374151"
LIGHT      = "#6B7280"
RULE_CLR   = "#C5C0B5"
NAVY_CARD  = "#112B50"
COBALT_DK  = "#153D78"

def F(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONTS, name), size)

# Pre-load fonts once
f_arsenal44 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_arsenal46 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_arsenal52 = F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf", 52)
f_bigs232   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 232)
f_bigs132   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 132)
f_bigs194   = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 194)
f_bigs64    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 64)
f_bigs86    = F("BigShoulders-Bold.ttf", 86)
f_ws80      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 80)
f_ws96      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 96)
f_ws60      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 60)
f_ws56      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 56)
f_ws50      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 50)
f_ws52      = F("WorkSans-Bold.ttf", 52)
f_wr46      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 46)
f_wr44      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_wr40      = F("WorkSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_is52      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 52)
f_is_it52   = F("InstrumentSans-Italic.ttf",  52)
f_is44      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 44)
f_is40      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_is38      = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf", 38)
f_dm42      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 42)
f_dm40      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 40)
f_dm36      = F("DMMono-Regular.ttf", 36)
f_ibm72     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf", 72)
f_ibm50     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf", 50)

def tw(txt, f):
    b = f.getbbox(txt); return b[2]-b[0]

def th(txt, f):
    b = f.getbbox(txt); return b[3]-b[1]

def T(text, x, y, f, fill=DARK, anchor="lt"):
    draw.text((x, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor=anchor)

def CT(text, cx, y, f, fill=DARK):
    draw.text((cx, y), text, font=f, fill=fill, anchor="mt")

def rule(y, x0=190, x1=W-190, c=RULE_CLR, w=2):
    draw.line([(x0,y),(x1,y)], fill=c, width=w)

def rr(x0,y0,x1,y1, r=16, fill=None, outline=None, ow=2):
    if fill:    draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, fill=fill)
    if outline: draw.rounded_rectangle([x0,y0,x1,y1], radius=r, outline=outline, width=ow)

def wrap(text, f, maxw):
    words, lines, cur = text.split(), [], []
    for w in words:
        test = " ".join(cur+[w])
        if tw(test,f) <= maxw: cur.append(w)
        else:
            if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
            cur = [w]
    if cur: lines.append(" ".join(cur))
    return lines

def WT(text, x, y, f, maxw, fill=DARK, gap=8):
    cy = y
    for ln in wrap(text,f,maxw):
        T(ln,x,cy,f,fill=fill)
        cy += th(ln,f)+gap
    return cy

def eyebrow(label, y, x=190):
    T(label.upper(), x, y, f_arsenal44, fill=GOLD)
    return y + 58

ML = 190
MR = W-190
CW = MR-ML    # 3128 px

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. HEADER
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
HDR_H = 548
draw.rectangle([0,0,W,HDR_H], fill=NAVY)
draw.rectangle([0,HDR_H,W,HDR_H+7], fill=GOLD)

T("WORLD BANK GROUP", ML, 52,  f_arsenal46, fill=GOLD)
T("GLOBAL ECONOMIC PROSPECTS  ·  2025", ML, 112, f_arsenal40 := F("ArsenalSC-Regular.ttf",40), fill="#7A9DC0")

T("RESILIENCE",       ML, 172, f_bigs232, fill=LINEN)
T("AMID UNCERTAINTY", ML, 385, f_bigs132, fill="#7A9DC0")

T("Annual Report · 2025", MR, 62, f_dm40, fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

tag1 = "The global economy's strongest recovery"
tag2 = "in six decades — and the risks ahead"
T(tag1, MR, 356, f_is_it52, fill="#7A9DC0", anchor="rt")
T(tag2, MR, 416, f_is_it52, fill="#5A80A8", anchor="rt")

y = HDR_H + 78

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. METRIC TRIO
#    Heights computed so nothing crowds:
#    big numeral: 194pt → renders ~184px h
#    sub-label:    64pt → ~58px h
#    separator + two captions: 12 + 16 + 44 + 10 + 38 = 120px
#    total content = 184+58+120 = 362 → CARD_H = 370
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
y = eyebrow("Historic Recovery", y)
rule(y, c=GOLD, w=3); y += 40

CARD_W = (CW - 2*52) // 3
CARD_H = 370

def metric_card(cx, cy, big, sub, l1, l2, bg, ncol, scol, lcol):
    mid = cx + CARD_W//2
    rr(cx, cy, cx+CARD_W, cy+CARD_H, r=20, fill=bg)
    # big numeral
    CT(big, mid, cy+14, f_bigs194, fill=ncol)
    # sub label
    CT(sub, mid, cy+14+184, f_bigs64, fill=scol)
    # separator
    sep = cy + 14 + 184 + 62
    rule(sep, x0=cx+50, x1=cx+CARD_W-50,
         c="#FFFFFF55" if bg==NAVY_CARD else RULE_CLR, w=1)
    # captions
    CT(l1, mid, sep+16, f_is44,           fill=lcol)
    CT(l2, mid, sep+72, f_is38,           fill=lcol)

metric_card(ML,                   y, "6",    "DECADES",
            "STRONGEST RECOVERY", "SINCE 1960",
            NAVY_CARD, GOLD, "#8BB0D0", "#7A9DC0")

metric_card(ML+CARD_W+52,        y, "1.2B",  "YOUTH",
            "ENTERING WORKING AGE", "NEXT DECADE",
            OFF_WHITE, NAVY, COBALT, LIGHT)

metric_card(ML+2*(CARD_W+52),    y, "2030",  "TARGETS",
            "WORLD BANK GROUP", "STRATEGIC PRIORITIES",
            COBALT_DK, LINEN, GOLD_LITE, "#8BB0D0")

y += CARD_H + 78

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. RISKS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Risks to the Outlook", y)
T("Key Downside Risks", ML, y, f_ws96, fill=NAVY)
y += th("Key Downside Risks", f_ws96) + 16
T("Growth could falter if trade tensions escalate or financial conditions deteriorate sharply.",
  ML, y, f_is_it52, fill=STEEL)
y += 80

risks = [
    ("01","Trade Tensions",
     "Escalating tariffs & retaliatory measures disrupt supply chains, dampen investment."),
    ("02","Financial Volatility",
     "Sentiment deterioration tightens financing conditions, especially for EMDEs."),
    ("03","Inventory Correction",
     "Firms drawing down front-loaded stocks, reducing near-term aggregate demand."),
    ("04","Climate Shocks",
     "Extreme weather threatens agricultural output & infrastructure in vulnerable regions."),
]

RISK_W = (CW-52)//2
RISK_H = 240
RISK_GAP = 28

for i,(num,title,body) in enumerate(risks):
    col,row = i%2,i//2
    rx = ML + col*(RISK_W+52)
    ry = y + row*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP)
    bg = "#EBF0F7" if col==0 else OFF_WHITE
    rr(rx,ry,rx+RISK_W,ry+RISK_H, r=14, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([rx,ry,rx+7,ry+RISK_H], fill=GOLD)
    T(num,   rx+28, ry+16, f_dm40, fill=GOLD)
    T(title, rx+28, ry+64, f_ws60, fill=NAVY)
    WT(body, rx+28, ry+138, f_wr46, maxw=RISK_W-62, fill=MID, gap=8)

y += 2*(RISK_H+RISK_GAP) + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. POLICY ACTIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("Policy Framework", y)
T("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", ML, y, f_ws80, fill=NAVY)
y += th("Policy Actions for Sustained Growth", f_ws80) + 42

policies = [
    ("Trade",      ["Multilateral environment","Diversify trade partners"]),
    ("Finance",    ["Ease EMDE constraints","Macro policy frameworks"]),
    ("Climate",    ["Scale risk mitigation","Resilient infrastructure"]),
    ("Investment", ["Catalyze private capital","Remove bottlenecks"]),
    ("Jobs",       ["Cross-border mobility","Skills development"]),
]

POL_W = (CW-4*20)//5
POL_H = 258

for i,(area,actions) in enumerate(policies):
    px = ML + i*(POL_W+20)
    py = y
    bg = "#E2EBF5" if i%2==0 else OFF_WHITE
    tc = NAVY if i%2==0 else COBALT
    rr(px,py,px+POL_W,py+POL_H, r=12, fill=bg)
    draw.rectangle([px,py,px+POL_W,py+6], fill=COBALT)
    CT(area,px+POL_W//2,py+18,f_ws56,fill=tc)
    rule(py+88, x0=px+16, x1=px+POL_W-16, c=RULE_CLR, w=1)
    cy = py+102
    for ln in actions:

        cy += 56

y += POL_H + 72

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. STRATEGIC PRIORITIES
#    Three columns with MEASURED gap between name and number.

rule(y); y += 44
y = eyebrow("World Bank Group 2030 Targets", y)
T("Strategic Priorities", ML, y, f_ws80, fill=NAVY)
y += th("Strategic Priorities", f_ws80) + 36

targets = [
    ("Health Services", "1.5B",  "people — quality, affordable health services"),
    ("Mission 300",     "300M",  "people in Sub-Saharan Africa — electricity access"),
    ("AgriConnect",     "300M",  "farmers — moving up the agricultural value chain"),
    ("Women's Capital", "80M",   "women & women-led businesses — access to capital"),
    ("Water Forward",   "1B+",   "people — improved water security  ·  400M WBG commitment"),
]

INIT_X  = ML + 24

DESC_X  = ML + 846    # description column start
DESC_W  = MR - DESC_X - 16

TGT_H   = 118
TGT_GAP = 10

for i,(init,val,desc) in enumerate(targets):
    ty = y + i*(TGT_H+TGT_GAP)
    if i%2==0:
        draw.rectangle([ML,ty-4,MR,ty+TGT_H+4], fill=OFF_WHITE)
    draw.rectangle([ML,ty,ML+6,ty+TGT_H-4], fill=COBALT)

    init_h = th(init, f_ws50)
    num_h  = th(val,  f_bigs86)
    desc_h = th(desc, f_wr44)

    T(init, INIT_X, ty+(TGT_H-init_h)//2, f_ws50, fill=NAVY)
    T(val,  NUM_X,  ty+(TGT_H-num_h)//2,  f_bigs86, fill=GOLD)
    T(desc, DESC_X, ty+(TGT_H-desc_h)//2, f_wr44, fill=MID)

y += len(targets)*(TGT_H+TGT_GAP) + 72

TH_COL_W = (CW-60)//2
TH_ROW   = 124
TH_GAP   = 14

for i,(theme,detail) in enumerate(themes):
    col,row = i%2,i//2
    tx = ML + col*(TH_COL_W+60)

    draw.ellipse([tx,ty+32,tx+16,ty+48], fill=COBALT)

FOOTER_Y = H-162

rem = BAND_Y - y - 16

if rem >= 80:
    draw.rectangle([0,y,W,BAND_Y], fill="#EAE6DC")
    draw.rectangle([0,y,W,y+4],           fill=GOLD)

    q1 = "Resilience is necessary — it is not sufficient."
